standard.title: Standard clean — packing list

items.name: Vacuum with floor, upholstery and crevice attachments
items.note: Bring clean filters and an empty bag/bin; use the correct head for each surface.

items.name: Microfiber mop, clean pads and bucket
items.note: Bring enough clean pads for the home and keep bathroom pads separate.

items.name: Broom and dustpan
items.note: For loose debris and areas unsuitable for the vacuum.

items.name: Color-coded microfiber cloths and glass cloths
items.note: Separate kitchen, bathroom and toilet cloths; pack clean replacements.

items.name: Non-scratch sponges, scrub pads and soft scrub brushes
items.note: Use only on compatible finishes.

items.name: Dedicated toilet brush
items.note: Keep separate from other cleaning tools.

items.name: Extendable duster
items.note: For reachable fixtures, corners and surface dusting.

items.name: Cleaning caddy and labeled spray bottles
items.note: Keep every product identified; bring manufacturer instructions/SDS access.

items.name: Charged phone with Turnly access and charger / power bank
items.note: Needed for the checklist, notes, required walkthrough videos and any customer opt-out.

items.name: Surface-compatible all-purpose cleaner
items.note: For washable counters and general surfaces.

items.name: Glass and mirror cleaner
items.note: Use with a clean lint-free cloth.

items.name: pH-neutral floor cleaner
items.note: Choose the product approved for the floor finish.

items.name: Bathroom / soap-scum cleaner
items.note: Use a finish-compatible product for sinks, tubs and showers.

items.name: Toilet-bowl cleaner
items.note: Use only as labeled; keep separate from other chemicals.

items.name: Mild dish detergent
items.note: For compatible washable items and mild cleaning.

items.name: Surface-specific cleaner, if needed
items.note: Bring stone-safe, wood-safe or stainless-steel products when those finishes are present.

items.name: EPA-registered kitchen / bathroom surface sanitizer
items.note: The standard checklist includes sanitizing sinks and toilets. Use products labeled for those surfaces; clean first, observe label contact time and follow any food-contact rinse directions.

items.name: Chemical-resistant gloves and label-required PPE
items.note: Bring eye protection where the product label requires it.

items.name: Trash bags and replacement liners
items.note: Match the sizes needed for the home.

items.name: Disposable towels and separate bags for used cloths
items.note: Contain dirty materials separately from clean supplies.

items.name: Non-slip footwear and shoe covers where requested
items.note: Use covers only where they do not create a slipping hazard.

notes: Pack enough product, cloths, pads and liners for the assigned home size and number of bathrooms. Check job-specific notes before traveling.
Follow product labels for dilution, PPE, ventilation, surface compatibility and any rinsing. Never mix cleaning chemicals.
Test unfamiliar products on an inconspicuous area. Respect homeowner product restrictions and document missing supplies in the checklist; contact Turnly if you cannot complete the assigned scope.

items.note: For compatible washable items and mild cleaning.

items.note: Contain dirty materials separately from clean supplies.

items.name: Non-slip footwear and shoe covers where requested
items.note: Use covers only where they do not create a slipping hazard.

items.name: Detail brushes and grout brush
items.note: For edges, tracks and compatible grout.

items.name: Non-scratch plastic scraper
items.note: For compatible surfaces only; no razor blades on delicate finishes.

items.name: Extra microfiber cloths, scrub pads and mop pads
items.note: Allow for heavier buildup and more frequent changes.

items.name: Stable step stool and extension tools
items.note: For safely reachable high areas within the assigned scope.

items.name: EPA-registered hard-surface sanitizer
items.note: Required for deep cleans. Choose a product labeled for the intended surface and sanitizing use; clean first and keep the surface wet for the label contact time.

items.name: Food-contact surface sanitizer, where applicable
items.note: Required when sanitizing food-contact surfaces. One product may cover both uses if its label permits; follow its food-contact directions and rinse requirements.

items.name: Surface-compatible degreaser
items.note: For heavier kitchen grease; follow label dilution and rinse directions.

items.name: Limescale / mineral-deposit remover, where compatible
items.note: Only for suitable fixtures and surfaces; do not use acidic products on natural stone or other acid-sensitive finishes.

items.name: Oven cleaner — only if interior oven cleaning is assigned
items.note: Use only on an appliance/finish that permits it; check self-cleaning oven restrictions.

items.name: Specialty stain or grout cleaner — only if needed
items.note: Use a compatible product within the checklist scope; do not combine it with other chemicals.

notes: Pack enough product, cloths, pads and liners for the assigned home size and number of bathrooms. Check job-specific notes before traveling.
Follow product labels for dilution, PPE, ventilation, surface compatibility and any rinsing. Never mix cleaning chemicals.
Test unfamiliar products on an inconspicuous area. Respect homeowner product restrictions and document missing supplies in the checklist; contact Turnly if you cannot complete the assigned scope.
Sanitizing and disinfecting are different claims. If the checklist specifically requires disinfection, bring an EPA-registered disinfectant labeled for that use and follow its full directions.
